name: B10-0424/2026 – § 5 – Am 94
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for an EU strategy to counter Islamist entryism and the influence of the Muslim Brotherhood network
part_text: 5. Condemns any discourse that seeks to problematise the ‘entryism’ of any minority group into European politics, as it risks denying to that minority group any legitimate means of political participation in their own society and has a catastrophic history in European politics;
